title: Y Crispy Winey Spanish Wrap
description: This energizing dish features crispy English muffins with a mediterranean twist and infused with wine for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Wine (red or white)
ingredients.notes: Any type of wine can be used, such as Pinot Noir for a slight sweetness or Cabernet Sauvignon for a more robust taste.

instructions: Place the English muffins on a baking sheet and toast them until golden brown.
In a small saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for about 2 minutes or until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes, wine, and balsamic vinegar to the saucepan with garlic. Cook gently for about 5-7 minutes until slightly thickened.
Spread the tomato-wine mixture evenly on each toasted English muffin.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley before serving.
Serve immediately as a light lunch option.
